name: Rice Croquettes
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: 1 saltspoonful of powdered cinnamon or nutmeg
ingredients.originalText: 1 saltspoonful of powdered cinnamon or nutmeg
ingredients.quantityText: 1 saltspoonful of powdered cinnamon or nutmeg

instructions.text: Put three-quarters of a cup of milk in a sauce-pan over the fire with a generous tablespoonful of butter, a heaping teaspoonful of sugar, and, when it comes to a boil, add a cup and a half of boiled rice, a saltspoonful of powdered cinnamon or nutmeg, and salt to taste.
Mix well, let it come to a boil.
Add a beaten egg, remove from the fire, turn into a plate to get cold, form into cylinders and fry in hot butter.

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put three-quarters of a cup of milk in a sauce-pan over the fire with a generous tablespoonful of butter, a heaping teaspoonful of sugar, and, when it comes to a boil, add a cup and a half of boiled rice, a saltspoonful of powdered cinnamon or nutmeg, and salt to taste.
2. Mix well, let it come to a boil.
3. Add a beaten egg, remove from the fire, turn into a plate to get cold, form into cylinders and fry in hot butter.
